verdict.rationale: Langfuse's API & data platform overview lists an official CLI for working with Langfuse "from a terminal or coding agent" [langfuse-docs-30]. It also points AI tools that cannot run shell commands to the MCP server instead [langfuse-docs-39], which signals the CLI is the intended agent-facing path. The evidence, however, amounts to one table-row mention with no command reference or usage detail. Missing for 10: CLI command and feature documentation, installation and auth details, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use.
